about_the_game:
This album illustrates the incredible return to the saga's origins, embodied by Ryu's disciple Kenji Mozu and black spider clan assassin Kumori. It blends different genres: synthwave, rock, Japanese retro tunes and action-packed arcade music that respect the original soundtrack of the NES games while modernizing it.

To make it happen, Sergio de Prado from The Game Kitchen has united with iconic composers of the NINJA GAIDEN series: Keiji Yamagishi, Kaori Nakabai and Ryuichi Nitta. Together, they created a unique soundtrack that represents the rebirth of the saga’s spirit.

The game's OST even features a bonus song by the famous city-pop artist Hitomitoi!
